The '''2015 Copa Sudamericana finals''' were the two-legged final that decided the winner of the [[2015 Copa Sudamericana]], the 14th edition of the [[Copa Sudamericana]], [[South America]]'s secondary international club [[association football|football]] tournament organized by [[CONMEBOL]].

The finals were contested in two-legged home-and-away format between Argentine team [[Club Atlético Huracán|Huracán]] and Colombian team [[Independiente Santa Fe|Santa Fe]]. The first leg was hosted by Huracán at [[Estadio Tomás Adolfo Ducó]] in [[Buenos Aires]] on 2 December 2015, while the second leg was hosted by Santa Fe at [[Estadio El Campín]] in [[Bogotá]] on 9 December.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/27112015-1815/horarios-definidos-para-los-partidos-de-la-gran-final-de-la-copa-sudamericana|title=Horarios definidos para los partidos de la gran final de la Copa Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=27 November 2015|language=Spanish}}</ref> The winner qualified for the [[2016 Copa Libertadores]], and earned the right to play against the [[2015 Copa Libertadores]] winners in the [[2016 Recopa Sudamericana]], and against the [[2015 J. League Cup]] winners in the [[2016 Suruga Bank Championship]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento_copa_sudamericana_2015.pdf|title=Copa Sudamericana 2015 – Reglamento|language=Spanish|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

As both the first leg<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/02122015-2259/copa-sudamericana-huracan-y-santa-fe-empataron-0-0-en-la-primera-final|title=Copa Sudamericana: Huracán y Santa Fe empataron 0 a 0 en la primera final|language=Spanish|date=2 December 2015|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> and the second leg<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/10122015-0017/copa-sudamericana-independiente-santa-fe-es-campeon-tras-vencer-en-penales-huracan|title=Copa Sudamericana: Independiente Santa Fe es campeón tras vencer en penales a Huracán|language=Spanish|date=9 December 2015|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> were tied 0–0, the champion was decided by penalty shoot-out in which Santa Fe won 3–1, winning the tournament for the first time in their history.

==Format==
The finals were played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] would not be used, and 30 minutes of [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] would be played. If still tied after extra time, the [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winner.<ref name="regulations"/>
